plugins.faceIDPermission: Kavutė does not use Face ID. Your sign-in is kept in the device’s secure storage without biometrics.

plugins.photosPermission: Kavutė opens your photo library only when you choose a photo to attach to a coffee rating. The photo you pick is uploaded and shown with that rating.
plugins.cameraPermission: Kavutė uses the camera only when you choose to take a photo of your coffee to attach to a rating.
plugins.microphonePermission: Kavutė only takes still photos and never records sound, so the microphone is not used.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Kavutė uses your location while the app is open to centre the map on you and to suggest the café you are in when you rate a coffee. Your location is not saved to your account.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Kavutė only uses your location while the app is open, to centre the map on you and suggest the café you are in. It never tracks you in the background.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Kavutė only uses your location while the app is open, to centre the map on you and suggest the café you are in. It never tracks you in the background.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: Kavutė does not use motion or activity data.
